about_the_game:
Purchase this DLC to host Terraforming Mars games. Other players do not need to purchase it to join.

1-5 Players | 90-120 mins

Recommended Age: 12+

Transform the Red Planet and shape the future of humanity in Terraforming Mars!

In the year 2400, humanity begins its ambitious journey to terraform Mars. As the CEO of a corporation, you’ll manage massive projects aimed at transforming the Red Planet into a livable environment. Use resources wisely to fund groundbreaking technologies, construct cities, and establish green zones while competing with other corporations for dominance.

Each turn, you’ll draft project cards that introduce unique advancements, from launching satellites to breeding new species. Carefully manage your resources (money, energy, heat, etc.) to complete projects and activate powerful abilities tied to specific cards. As Mars becomes habitable, your cities and forests will shape the map, while milestones and awards will determine the ultimate victor.

Key Features:

  • Strategic Depth: Plan ahead as you compete for resources and milestones.

  • Over 200 Project Cards: Explore endless possibilities with unique abilities and combinations.

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Balance immediate actions with long-term strategies to terraform the planet.

  • Solo or Multiplayer: Play alone or compete with up to 4 other players.

  • Endless Replayability: Randomized project cards ensure a fresh experience every game.

Can your corporation lead humanity to a new frontier, or will others surpass your vision?

short_description: Lead a corporation competing in the race to make Mars habitable. Terraforming Mars is a strategic board game where players use resources, innovative technology, and long-term planning to raise the planet’s temperature, create oceans, and build a breathable atmosphere.
